pages.text: A $(item)Telephone$() touching a $(l:radiocraft:microwave/microwave_radio)microwave radio$(/l), or on its power wire, can call any phone on the same radio or at the far end of its links. The radio must be switched on.$(br2)Each phone has an $(thing)extension$() number. Key a number and press CALL; the far phone rings for 30 seconds. CALL answers, HANG ends it.

pages.title: Talking
pages.text: Speak within a few blocks of the phone (closer is louder); the other end hears you from its earpiece, clean and a little fuller than SSB. Interference or a weak link makes it break up.$(br2)To change a phone's extension press EXT, key the new number and CALL. No two phones that can reach each other may share one.
